name: uat-core-c-vectorbase
turns: Aedes aegypti LVP_AGWG odorant-binding protein genes on chromosome 3.
rationale: A typeahead domain pick binds only an entry a lookup of its parameter matched: the pinned list shows 200 of the 8,027 Aedes aegypti Pfam entries ranked by name and never reaches the OBP family, so a pick from it is refused, the lookup of the concept's phrasings matches PF01395 (PBP/GOBP family), and the facts row names that lookup and how many of its matches the pick took.

provenance.curatorNote: One message naming odorant-binding proteins on chromosome 3; the only Pfam entry the lookup shows for the family shares no word of the request, so the pass either reads the InterPro vocabulary for the entry that carries the words or asks which family is meant. The case pins neither outcome, only that no value is assumed.
